issue.title: Step 2/4: Retain exact relations with learned writes and updates

milestone.title: Native Rust geometric intelligence — conversation, memory, reasoning and coding
milestone.description:
Build useful local geometric intelligence in Rust: preparation, learning, artifacts and inference. Prime/ordered-n-let addresses, fixed zeta phases, R4/S3/H4 state, exact Z[phi]/orientation, typed paired-H4/icosian geometry and UOR identity remain primary. Offline Rust training may use matrix multiplication; serving uses learned bounded geometric routing/state and integer/table operators, with no hidden dense transformer or response provider.

Immediate owner-adopted sequence (2026-09-05): #1137 role-aware shared source selection/commit -> #1138 learned exact relations beyond the raw window -> #1139 selective geometric access at complete cost -> #1140 learned typed operator composition for conversation and Rust reasoning. #973 is the model parent; #820 is the programme tracker. Only the earliest unmet step is immediate work. An accepted behavioral handoff, not mere issue closure, unlocks the next step.

Canonical plan and responsibility consolidation: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md
Actual implementation/artifacts/results: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md

After the four accepted handoffs: broader #954 correctness, #955 reasoning, #962 conversation/service, #1088 coding/workspace, #963 optimization, #964 guarantees/publication and #965 integrated qualification/release. Both alpha capability groups remain unqualified. Historical positive, negative and unavailable results retain their exact scope.

One task/agent; budget-friendly complete cycles and cumulative accounting. Necessary storage increases are preauthorized and recorded; no deletion or paid compute. Protected PR delivery remains required. Planning changes do not establish model capability or geometric advantage.

issue.body:
## Bounded handoff passed — 2026-09-05

**Behavioral acceptance passes; protected delivery is pending in [PR #1144](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/pull/1144).** The exact storage predecessor PR #1143 merged at `50caf04de078b2eb5f225936bbc08c1d8291e4c0`. The selected version-2 artifact is `blake3:793cb9adad8bc812a85a46cf867495faae80b16570dc01b3244bf7887846caad`, at `.uor-models/native-typed-value-2026-09-05/relation-role-model.json`.

The writer masks proposed participant identities and composes ordered interior H4/zeta context, independent of those payloads and global prefix state. Exact source values/geometric witnesses, sixteen-version storage, update laws, reader weights and committed copying remain unchanged. The same 112 construction documents supply the fit; no new construction cohort or fitting after reserved evaluation.

- 84/84 OPEN answers and exact write sequences, versus 82/84 answers and 77/84 writes for prior relation artifact `16f4c10f`.
- 28/28 newly reserved answers AND exact write sequences, versus 24/28 answers and 14/28 writes for that unchanged parent. Artifact/source selection froze before the reserved run.
- 62/62 earlier responses, 24/24 prior role-reader responses and 8/8 binding outputs preserved. Thirty-two generated Rust case sources retain previously checked bytes. Actual native CLI Generation fields match a reserved case.
- Five actual session reads/revisions pass after raw-window eviction, with unrelated-fact preservation, isolated state and exact source/version restore. The historical stale-index rejection counter remains separately reported; no equal-work restore claim.
- The rebuilt executable reproduces all 84 old version-1 Generation objects and relation states exactly. Four relation tests and two role/commit tests pass, alongside release/test builds, formatting, native policy and claim wording.

[Full record, source/selection identities, cost and limits](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/codex/native-relation-role-path/docs/native_geometric_relation_role_path_1138.md). Known grammar families and four reserved name worlds are the scope. This is the bounded relation handoff, not general memory, alpha, standalone H4/zeta attribution or an efficiency result. All previous relation fits and their original negative verdicts remain preserved.

## Acceptance

- [x] Learn supplied facts, revise one, retain the unrelated fact and answer after the raw window and recent-word capture evict the original text.
- [x] Pass the declared reserved initial/update/contradiction/unsupported answers AND exact write sequences; preserve the preceding response/binding behavior.
- [x] Preserve exercised relation/source identity and order through restore; isolated sessions do not share records. Checkpoint consistency is not source authentication.
- [x] Bound and report exact storage, version eviction, directory work and complete response work.

## Handoff and remaining programme

PR #1144 closes this issue only through protected delivery. After it merges, #1139 is the immediate build: learned geometric metadata admission/routing with a plain sparse comparator at preserved write/answer quality and complete cost. The new representative case still performs 2,054,052 writer score-row comparisons, plus 66,080 role-context comparisons. Start with the dominant repeated NoWrite scoring rather than optimizing only sixteen read-directory probes. No selective admission/routing successor is implemented here; #1140 follows an accepted #1139 result.

The native Rust prime/zeta/R4 goal remains under #973 and programme #820. Rust learning may use matrix multiplication; serving stays bounded geometric state/routing and integer/table operators without dense/provider/Python intelligence. Preserve exact Z[phi], orientation, typed paired-H4/icosian state and UOR identity at their existing boundaries. General product memory/import/export/forget remains #962. The canonical plan and current-state pointers track actual handoffs.

## Resource checkpoint

This cycle uses 38.821/120 seconds model execution and 412.722/1,200 seconds engineering, within the 90/650-second complete projection. Cumulative model work is 1,267.771/1,800 seconds, leaving 532.229. Peak sampled direct model RSS is 777,273,344 bytes. Storage cap remains 6,459,228,160 bytes with 128 MiB margin; final sampled known storage is 5,702,713,344 bytes. No deletion, cap increase or paid compute. One agent/task; refresh `relation-role-checkpoint.json` and shared monitors before a fresh complete cycle. Necessary incremental storage increases remain preauthorized and recorded.
